experiment_data.hypothesis: High Fleiss kappa (low independence) is a general property of same-model aggregation, not specific to SC+SICA. LLM-Debate and Diverse-Prompt aggregation on Mistral-7B will also exhibit high kappa and low Effective K, confirming the independence bottleneck is fundamental to single-model ensembles regardless of aggregation method.
